mapper.select: SELECT qr.*, p.name as patient_name, p.gender as patient_gender, p.phone as patient_phone, d.username as doctor_name, d.employee_number as doctor_employee_number FROM questionnaire_record qr LEFT JOIN patient p ON qr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON qr.doctor_id = d.id WHERE qr.id = #{id}

SELECT qr.*, p.name as patient_name, p.gender as patient_gender, p.phone as patient_phone, d.username as doctor_name, d.employee_number as doctor_employee_number FROM questionnaire_record qr LEFT JOIN patient p ON qr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON qr.doctor_id = d.id WHERE qr.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY qr.assessment_date DESC, qr.create_time DESC

SELECT qr.*, p.name as patient_name, p.gender as patient_gender, p.phone as patient_phone, d.username as doctor_name, d.employee_number as doctor_employee_number FROM questionnaire_record qr LEFT JOIN patient p ON qr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON qr.doctor_id = d.id INNER JOIN patient_doctor pd ON qr.patient_id = pd.patient_id WHERE qr.patient_id = #{patientId} AND pd.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY qr.assessment_date DESC, qr.create_time DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE questionnaire_record SET patient_id = #{patientId}, admission_number = #{admissionNumber}, assessment_date = #{assessmentDate}, selections = #{selections}, item_scores = #{itemScores}, total_score = #{totalScore}, category_scores = #{categoryScores}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, doctor_username = #{doctorUsername}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy}, user_input_data = #{userInputData}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(assessment_date) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM questionnaire_record WHERE assessment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(assessment_date) ORDER BY date ASC
